mobile.title: Sign in to Solaria Mobile

mobile.fallback: If the app does not open, install it and start a new sign-in from the app.

email.pending: Open the link sent to your email and confirm to continue.
email.unavailable: Email delivery is unavailable. Try again later.

professional.optional: Other certificates are optional and can improve your profile.
professional.saveError: Unable to save or submit. Check information and documents or refresh the review.
